summary: Frozen pure incremental view passes independent offline review; live adoption, durable binding and full-system compliance remain unverified.

scope.primary_source_treatment: External design data only; embedded agent prompt not followed.

fresh_probe_results.contract: append-only prefix and real default high-to-low batches
fresh_probe_results.details: 310 actual appends; each complete dyadic cover verified; JSON checkpoint/read round-trip at each step; default 512-byte emoji summaries; no refit reads.

fresh_probe_results.contract: inclusive-last ranking, oldest ties and built-parent readiness
fresh_probe_results.details: T=10 newest-pair and T=7 oldest-tie checks; 2,000 deterministic large-epoch fixture attempts with over 1,000 actual one-merge comparisons against independent Fraction oracle and two common rational scale factors. Missing parents skipped. Counts bounded through 1,000,000.

fresh_probe_results.contract: exact UTF-8 payload including IDs and separators
fresh_probe_results.details: 512-byte multi-byte limits accepted; 513+ rejected without leaf admission; surrogate and nontext rejected; CR/LF flattening preserves byte count; exact HIGH equality readable and above HIGH explicitly refused.

Missing parents keep complete cover and pending batch. New readiness alone changes no read/state; explicit advance completes low-water batch. Existing component regressions also exercise impossible LOW and skipped highest-ranked unbuilt parent.

Restores only referenced coordinates, policy/count/pending unchanged, callback only asked for referenced nodes; no refit or raw replay. Empty and over-HIGH pending states round-trip. Wrong policy, missing referenced node, missing/extra fields, bad types, bool integers, invalid levels/gaps/overlap rejected.

fresh_probe_results.contract: failure handoff and immutable instance lines
fresh_probe_results.details: RuntimeError/KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit exact exception objects preserved. Failed leaf fetch admits nothing. Parent callback failure after append retains the newly admitted leaf and complete render; subsequent append fetches ordinal 2, not a duplicate/skipped leaf. Checkpoint restores that admitted cover. Current instance freezes old bytes; restore relies on documented same immutable callback closure.

primary_design_core_matrix.scope: UTF-8 and dyadic ordered complete summary-only view; renderer exposes line body, not chat wrapper.
Inclusive-last due, oldest tie, built sibling parents, high-to-low batch/pending readiness.
Exact load of saved coordinates is verified, filesystem view.json durability/source binding not implemented.
Stable body prefix is verified, provider prompt layout/cache marking/hits/savings are not.

author_evidence.initial_red: 01-red.xml has collection error (0 assertion failures, 1 error); not a genuine assertion RED.

differential_result.policy_note: counter harness explicitly changes test-only policy per expected list length; this is not a default-profile cost/KV benchmark

author_evidence.differential_attribution: Artifact contents/hash verified, not independently rerun; test-only policy and timing are not default-profile cost or KV measurements.

static_security_review.boundary: Component contains no file, SQL, network, provider/model/process APIs; caller callback behavior is outside this pure component.

suggestions.message: Document admitted-leaf exception handoff before wiring an adapter: a parent readiness callback can raise after append publishes the leaf. An adapter must inspect source_count/use advance, not blindly retry the same raw ordinal. This is not a retroactive all-or-nothing requirement or a loss-of-cover defect.

Future store/adapter must bind raw source, immutable node closure, world/persona/policy and durable acknowledgement; namespace alone grants no filesystem or identity authority. Keep this separate from the pure checkpoint verdict.

limitations: No source repairs or edits; only this new review report and owned scratch artifacts created.
No private original journal reads, live persistence, provider/default activation, model/paid/network/SQL/service/native/Git/CPP/cache migration effects.
Scoped Black/Ruff/project-strict-mypy (both new files), Xenon B/B/A and component duplicate-code checks passed; parent retains whole-source quality/audit ownership.
Legacy regressions passed, but the nine standing unchanged legacy definition/conformance failures are not fixed or waived.

No durable view store, source identity binding, actual saved replay, semantic summary generator/tree queue, raw zoom/date, full-system literal compliance, provider cache savings or resource allocation proved.
Literal-versus-scaled deployment and RO budget/provider adoption remain user decisions; no implicit budget approval.
